answer: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) is the standard automotive-industry procedure, defined in the AIAG reference manuals, through which a supplier proves to its customer that a new part — or a significant change to an existing one — can be produced at the quoted rate with consistent quality before volume production starts. It is delivered as a submission package (typically the Part Submission Warrant, dimensional results, material and performance test data, and process capability results such as Cpk), with submission levels 1–5 determining how much evidence is required.
